subject.title: Browser-opened temporary tabs/windows should close automatically after task completion

question: Should primary-agent browser tabs close at ordinary task completion by default, and if so what ownership/preservation contract should define a temporary tab?
rationale: Current behavior intentionally keeps active primary-session tabs reusable; changing that default can surprise users unless maintainers choose the terminal event, run-owned marker, and preservation rules.

options.title: Adopt run-owned cleanup
options.body: Track tabs opened by each primary-agent run and close them on terminal completion unless the user explicitly preserved or took ownership of them.

options.title: Keep idle/cap cleanup only
options.body: Leave current reusable primary-session behavior as the product contract and close this request after documenting why task-completion cleanup is not planned.

options.title: Add an explicit cleanup mode
options.body: Introduce a documented policy or config mode for task-completion cleanup while preserving the current default for upgrade safety.

recommendation.title: Adopt run-owned cleanup
recommendation.body: Track tabs opened by each primary-agent run and close them on terminal completion unless the user explicitly preserved or took ownership of them.

likelyOwner.reason: The current cleanup and session-reset code paths are recently owned by jalehman and are the likely place where the terminal boundary would be wired.
